scope: Independent CPU source/ABI audit plus synthetic probability/cache/CSV regression; no GPU, training, inference, plan locking or production output writes.

trainer_review.official_initialization: HSE official AffectNet7 checkpoint; native classes mapped [0,2,3,5,6,4]; old task weights absent
trainer_review.split: Fresh expanded grouping split 19120/4782; members/image hashes bound; no old task model/old probability evaluation
trainer_review.optimizer: All parameters trainable from epoch0; BN running buffers frozen and affine trainable; no head warmup/optimizer recreation; accumulated loss denominator actual logical group size
trainer_review.evaluation: Epoch0 diagnostic only; exactly epoch12 EMA selected; no per-epoch validation candidate selection
trainer_review.resume: Complete epoch state includes optimizer/scaler/EMA/RNG/history/counters; final model checked against epoch12 EMA shadow
trainer_review.export: New HSE original+flip only; fixed average; V8 incumbent preserved and candidate explicitly unranked against V8
trainer_review.metric_path: Raw float32 arrays retained; trainer.metrics consumes same raw view average in producer and finalizer, avoiding extra normalization in exact metric comparisons

limitations: No claim of GPU smoke or training execution: root performs that separately after locking sources.
External pretraining overlap with competition images is unknown.
New validation performance cannot be directly compared with old 72.4398% development score.
